mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 and industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 signals contraction in real economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200 AND INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), rate hikes increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A high GDP level (GDPC1 > 17000) indicates strong economic activity and corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 17000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Co-occurrence of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0) signals potential for aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240 AND FEDFUNDS < 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in total employment (PAYEMS) below 146000 indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 146000.
